name: Sar Auto Products Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1987, Sar Auto Products Ltd manufactures gears, gear boxes and other transmission components. It is also in the
business of Real Estate Development[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) It is in the business of manufacturing 
and selling Auto components, especially Gears for Transmission, Differential & Engine. 
b) SAPL manufactures Auto components comprising automobile gears like Spur 
Gear, Helical Gear, Straight Bevel Gear, Sprockets along with Transmission Spline Shafts, Couplings, and Power Take-off clutches which are used for Transmission, Engine, and Differential gearboxes
c) Co. manufactures gears, gearboxes, and other transmission components
d) Company has battery of CNC & VMC machines and can manufacture machined 
 parts up to 480 mm diameter.
e) It also has a Tool Room for the manufacture of jigs, fixtures, etc.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 56.6 to 37.4 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 59.8 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.34% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 40.4% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.13 Cr.
